purpose: Teach: 語句/教え子/腑/灌/學/実技/参謀/交錯

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、古文の難解な語句の読解を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you covered difficult vocabulary from classical Japanese in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Calm professional register. Slightly rising inflection on the check-in at the end. Noticing without testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、亡くなった先生方の教え子の追悼を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on a memorial piece about the students of late teachers.
lines.style: Respectful, precise. Direct eye contact. Careful with the weight of the subject matter. Measured pace. No rushing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 東洋医学の五臓六腑の概念を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined the classical medical concept of the five organs and six bowels, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently probing. Unhurried pace. Slight warmth — she's genuinely following the student's work. Not interrogating, conversing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、灌仏会、つまり花祭りの歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the history of Kanbutsu-e, the Flower Festival, through that lens.
lines.style: Calm and clear. Slight emphasis on the festival name as if grounding the abstraction. Direct. A student who has done the thinking.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 旧字体の學と新字体の学の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also traced the history of the old character form and the modern simplified form of that character, didn't you.
lines.style: Curious, patient. Drawing out the thread. Warm but professional. A teacher who genuinely wants to understand what the student discovered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、武道の実技審査の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the history and requirements of the martial arts practical examination system.
lines.style: Steady, slightly formal when naming the subject. Brief, confident. Speaking from solid research. No hedging.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦国時代の参謀役の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your research on the role of strategic advisors in the Sengoku period — how did you approach that?
lines.style: Open-ended, genuinely interested inflection on the question. Slow, inviting. Creating space for the student to elaborate. Teacher-mode listening.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政治と経済が交錯する事象を論文で扱いました
lines.en: I focused on moments where politics and economics intersected and shaped decision-making.
lines.style: Thoughtful conclusion. Confident. Slight settling in the voice — the natural end of a good academic discussion. Not rushed, but complete.
